MINUS.gloss: an arithmetic operation in which the difference between two numbers is calculated
MINUS.definition: An arithmetic operation in which the difference between two numbers is calculated.
MINUS.example: The subtraction of three from four leaves one.

SLIM.gloss: being of delicate or slender build
SLIM.definition: Being of delicate or slender build.
SLIM.example: She was slender as a willow shoot is slender"- Frank Norris.

SUN.gloss: the star that is the source of light and heat for the planets in the solar system
SUN.definition: The star that is the source of light and heat for the planets in the solar system.
SUN.example: The sun contains 99.85% of the mass in the solar system.

MIN.gloss: a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour
MIN.definition: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour.

SLUM.definition: A district of a city marked by poverty and inferior living conditions.
